abilities.name: Tengu Bowmanship
_curatorNotes: A1 (Immovable Will): when Crowfeather Cover is active, the Fully-Charged Aimed Shot uses reduced charge-time frames — gcsim models this as a distinct frame set (aimedA1Frames: swap=60, D=50, J=50). This is Sara's primary gameplay CA pattern (E → CA during cover). chargeHits[] records the standard non-A1 frames; reviewer should decide how to represent the A1 variant.
No plunge.go in gcsim character dir — plungeFrames not available.

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description: Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, crackling lightning will accumulate on the arrowhead. An arrow fully charged with the storm's might will deal Electro DMG.
When in the Crowfeather Cover state, a fully-charged arrow will leave a Crowfeather behind after it hits.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.name: Tengu Stormcall
_curatorNotes: Crowfeather Cover is an 18s self-status on Sara (gcsim: c.Core.Status.Add(coverKey, 18*60)), not a spawned entity — no summons[] authored. Reviewer to decide how to represent this status window.

ATK buff (Tengu Juurai: Ambush): in the base kit, the ATK buff fires from the Aimed attack (aimed.go) when CA is used during Crowfeather Cover, not from E itself. The Ambush hit fires at aimedA1Hitmark + travel + 90 frames after the CA; attackBuff applies to the active character at that frame. Duration: 6s (360f in gcsim, modifier.NewBaseWithHitlag). Scaling buff — value based on Sara's Base ATK; no value field when authoring effects[]. Reviewer to author effects[] entry on this skill.

C2 (Dark Wings): on E cast, a weaker Crowfeather also fires automatically at Sara's original position at c2Hitmark=103 frames from cast, dealing 30% of standard Ambush DMG and applying the same ATK buff to the active character (gcsim: skill.go QueueAttack delay=50, hitmark=103).
abilities.description:
Retreats rapidly with the speed of a tengu, summoning the protection of the Crowfeather.
Gains Crowfeather Cover for 18s, and when Kujou Sara fires a fully-charged Aimed Shot, Crowfeather Cover will be consumed, and will leave a Crowfeather at the target location.
Crowfeathers will trigger Tengu Juurai: Ambush after a short time, dealing Electro DMG and granting the active character within its AoE an ATK Bonus based on Kujou Sara's Base ATK.

The ATK Bonuses from different Tengu Juurai will not stack, and their effects and duration will be determined by the last Tengu Juurai to take effect.

abilities.name: Subjugation: Koukou Sendou
_curatorNotes: ATK buff (Titanbreaker + Stormclusters): Titanbreaker fires at frame 51 from cast; Stormclusters begin at frame 100 and fire every 18 frames (6 ticks per cluster, 4 clusters base / 6 at C4). Each hit calls attackBuff on the active character. Duration: 6s (360f). Scaling buff — based on Sara's Base ATK; no value field. Reviewer to author effects[] entry.
C4 (Conclusive Proof): Stormcluster count increases from 4 to 6; total hit count increases accordingly (24 base → 36 at C4, plus 1 Titanbreaker).
abilities.description:
Casts down Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker, dealing AoE Electro DMG. Afterwards, Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker spreads out into 4 consecutive bouts of Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster, dealing AoE Electro DMG.
Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker and Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster can provide the active character within their AoE with the same ATK Bonus as given by the Elemental Skill, Tengu Stormcall.

The ATK Bonus provided by various kinds of Tengu Juurai will not stack, and their effects and duration will be determined by the last Tengu Juurai to take effect.

constellations.name: Sin of Pride
_curatorNotes: Inherited trigger: "manual" — likely fires when Tengu Juurai applies ATK buff to a character via attackBuff() (both E-path Ambush and Q Titanbreaker/Stormclusters). gcsim (cons.go): c6() is called from attackBuff() after each Juurai hit, adding an attack mod (modifier.NewBaseWithHitlag(c6Key, 360)) to the buffed character. Duration: 6s (360f). Applies to Electro DMG only (element check in Amount func). target: "self" in current skeleton appears incorrect — should be the active character who received the ATK boost, not Sara. Reviewer to update trigger type, target, and duration.
